text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I would like to thank you all for 
participating today.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: No, thank YOU guys!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: How did you find singing together with us?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, this is not the end. Are both 
your heart rates and body temperatures 
rising?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! The hype is real!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: How about Stage B?

text_block_list.name: B-Stage Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! Things are really heating up over 
here too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Alright everyone! Here comes the 
next song!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"I had no idea concerts could be this much 
fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um... Hello-san!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
? Is something the matter? Is there an 
issue with the stage?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No. That's not it. There's something I 
want to tell you in person.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I end up as a 
backdancer, I'll keep doing my best to aim 
for center.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because I realized there are so many fans 
waiting for me out there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to share my gratitude with 
a smile, no matter the time. —Thank you 
very much!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. We fans will always be watching 
over you all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... So tired~. The girl on the next 
stage is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Me! Tag in, Falcon-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, passing the baton over to you! Go 
out there and rock the whole venue!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girls exchange high-fives and take 
turns rushing onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day's stage was filled with 
brilliance all day long—
